deliberate_trade_offs: Zero bundled cloud storage or bandwidth resale: agencies plug in their own Cloudflare R2 ($0.015/GB, $0 egress) or Bunny Stream ($0.01/GB storage, free H.264 transcoding) accounts, trading turnkey vendor billing for 70-85% lower multi-TB costs and direct file ownership.

No Camera-to-Cloud (C2C) hardware ingest, no Adobe Premiere/After Effects timeline panels, and no studio-grade DRM/SOC 2 vaulting — conceding Hollywood post houses to Frame.io V4 so corporate clients get a single-screen, zero-login review page instead of a cluttered database UI.

No per-member seat billing or internal approval hierarchies: every workspace is a flat $49/mo for unlimited staff, rotating freelance editors, and client links, intentionally leaving enterprise role-based permissions to Filestage and Frame.io Enterprise.

No broad marketing funnel analytics, email gates, or LMS course hosting — built strictly for agency client review, version-locked sign-off, final raw master delivery, and brandless client embed handoff.
indie_feasibility: Shippable by 1-2 indie developers in 8-10 weeks without running transcoding farms: Bunny Stream API handles adaptive HLS encoding at $0 transcoding fee while Cloudflare R2 handles $0-egress multi-GB raw master downloads via pre-signed URLs. Core v1 scope is an authenticated agency workspace, frame-accurate HTML5/HLS comment overlay (Vidstack), version-stack comparison, magic-link zero-login client sign-off with reliable email digests (Postmark/Resend), and a branded final download + clean embed page. Low support burden because customer storage/egress stays on their own R2/Bunny accounts; zero enterprise sales or compliance gates. [UNVETTED founder fit: assumes technical founder comfortable with media APIs and agency self-serve marketing.]

needs_stack_sketch.alternatives_above: Pay $400/mo annual for Vimeo Studio ($4,800/yr) or $15-$25/member/mo for Frame.io V4 plus separate final-delivery tools (Dropbox Replay at $10-$12/user/mo on top of paid Dropbox, VoiceDeck at ~$50/mo per 1TB storage cap, PlayPause at $9+/mo review-only without multi-TB BYO delivery/embeds, or VidPaar/Livid hosting without unified review-to-approval workflows), or hire a developer to build a custom Bunny/R2 client portal.
needs_stack_sketch.obviated_below: Configure raw Cloudflare R2 buckets, Bunny Stream flat collections, signed download URLs, and HLS embed snippets by hand, or reconcile client timestamp notes scattered across Slack, email, Google Drive, and 3GB-capped WeTransfer links.
needs_stack_sketch.promise_one_up: Get non-technical corporate clients to review cuts and sign off final masters in one pass without hand-holding calls, while cutting monthly agency video review and delivery overhead by 70-85%.
needs_stack_sketch.your_level: Run zero-login frame-accurate client video review, version-locked approval, and branded multi-GB final delivery/embeds from one flat-rate workspace backed by our own Cloudflare R2 or Bunny Stream account.

one_liner: A flat $49/mo client video review, sign-off, and final delivery portal backed by the agency's own Cloudflare R2 or Bunny Stream account — replacing Frame.io V4 per-seat taxes, Vimeo's $400/mo Studio tier, and WeTransfer's discontinued Portals & Reviews.
price: $49/mo flat workspace ($490/yr annual) — unlimited staff, rotating freelance editors, client reviewers, and projects; agency pays raw R2 ($0.015/GB, $0 egress) or Bunny Stream ($0.01/GB) directly.
specific_buyer: Boutique video production companies, commercial videographers, and video-producing marketing/creative agencies (2-15 staff plus rotating freelance editors and colorists, managing 5-30 external corporate or brand clients) delivering multi-gigabyte draft cuts for client feedback and final masters/embeds.
specific_problem: Boutique agencies lost WeTransfer Portals & Reviews (shut down Dec 2025), face Vimeo's $400/mo ($4,800/yr) Studio hike for corporate accounts, and hit Frame.io V4's cluttered UI, broken client notifications, and $15-$25/member/mo seat taxes on temporary freelancers. Sub-$100 rivals leave a verified structural gap: PlayPause ($9+/mo) and VoiceDeck (~$50/mo, hard upload pause at 1TB) stop at review on vendor-marked-up storage without multi-TB BYO final master delivery or brandless embeds, while VidPaar ($9.99-$62.49/mo) and Livid ($10-$24/mo) are hosts rather than zero-login client review-to-approval hubs. Path A adoption (Liquid = 1.0): agencies launch on their next client shoot with zero legacy migration.
title: BYO-Storage Client Video Review & Final Delivery Hub (Lens 1)

deliberate_trade_offs: Zero project-management bloat: no Kanban boards, Gantt charts, CRM pipelines, proposal builders, or resource-capacity grids — deliberately conceding all-in-one suites to Plutio ($49/mo), Productive.io ($25-$28/user/mo), and Teamwork ($24.99/user/mo) so agencies never have to migrate out of Linear, Asana, ClickUp, or Notion.

Flat $59/mo workspace with unlimited staff, part-time contractors, active/archived clients, projects, and invoices — refusing both per-seat taxes (Clockify/Toggl/Everhour) and activity-based Flex meters (Harvest) even when a 20-person agency adds 15 freelance contractors.
Built strictly for recurring monthly retainers and time-and-materials agency billing, not enterprise multi-entity ERP, payroll processing, or government DCAA timekeeping compliance.
Read-only client proof-of-hours portals with zero client logins (signed share URLs) instead of full multi-tenant client messaging/file workspaces, cutting portal admin overhead to zero.

needs_stack_sketch.your_level: Track unlimited staff and part-time contractor hours against rolling monthly retainers with live burn-vs-elapsed alerts, zero-login client proof-of-hours links, and 1-click QBO/Xero/Stripe draft invoices.

one_liner: A flat $59/mo agency retainer-burn, contractor time-tracking, and live client proof-of-hours billing hub with 1-click Harvest history import — eliminating Harvest's Flex usage taxes and Clockify/Toggl's per-contractor seat penalties.
price: $59/mo flat workspace ($590/yr annual) — unlimited staff, part-time contractors, clients, active/archived projects, retainers, and invoices synced to QBO/Xero/Stripe.
